create_type_checker_for_field: create a type checker instance for a protobuf FieldDescriptor using GetTypeChecker function
validate_int32_value: validate an int32 value using Int32ValueChecker to check type and range bounds
validate_float_value: validate a float value using FloatValueChecker to check type and 32-bit range
truncate_float_to_four_bytes: truncate a double precision float to four byte float using TruncateToFourByteFloat
get_shortest_wire_equivalent_float: get the shortest decimal representation of a float that preserves wire value using ToShortestFloat
